summary: VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- OceanaGold Corporation (TSX: OGC) (NYSE: OGC) ("OceanaGold" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that the shareholders of Ausgold Limited (ASX: AUC) ("Ausgold") have voted in favour of the scheme of arrangement under which OceanaGold will acquire 100% of the issued shares of Ausgold (the "Scheme" or the "Transaction"). The vote took place at the Scheme Meeting held on November 27, 2026.
title: OceanaGold Announces Ausgold Shareholder Approval
